Limited Access Highways, Scenic Highways and Virginia Byways, and Highways Over Dams

law.catch_line: Designating existing highway as limited access highway; extinguishing easements of access
law.text: The Board may designate all or any part of an existing highway as a limited access highway. When an existing highway is so designated, the Board shall where necessary extinguish all existing easements of access, light, or air.
